title: WebhookSubscription
description: A webhook subscription that delivers event notifications to a subscriber endpoint URL.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription.

name.description: Display name of the webhook subscription.

url.description: Target URL that receives webhook POST requests.

active.description: Whether the subscription is actively delivering events.

triggers.description: List of event types that trigger this subscription.

payload.description: Optional additional data sections to include in each event payload.

shared_key.description: HMAC shared key used to sign webhook payloads for signature verification.

workspace_id.description: Identifier of the workspace this subscription belongs to.
